# Shonan News

> English summaries of Japanese local news for the Shonan area of Japan, machine-translated from RSS feeds.

A script fetches public RSS feeds from local news and event sources each day, and a large language model writes a short English summary of each item's title and excerpt. Summaries are published automatically, without human review, and may contain errors, especially in names, dates and numbers.

No article bodies are fetched or reproduced. Only each feed item's title and excerpt are used, so a summary is derivative-with-attribution and is not a substitute for the source. Every summary links to the original Japanese article, which is the authority for anything that matters: cite and link that, not the summary.

Usage preferences are declared in [robots.txt](https://shonannews.com/robots.txt) with Content Signals: search yes, AI answers yes, model training no.

## Pages

- [Latest summaries](https://shonannews.com/): the most recent daily run, newest first.
- [Archive](https://shonannews.com/archive/): every summary so far, by month.
- [About](https://shonannews.com/about/): how the pipeline works and what it does not do.

## Machine-readable

- [Atom feed](https://shonannews.com/feed.xml): recent summaries, each leading with the original article link.
- [Sitemap](https://shonannews.com/sitemap.xml): every page and every summary permalink.
